newsitem.title: USA: Industry to admit tobacco addictive in deal.
newsitem.headline: Industry to admit tobacco addictive in deal.

text.p: Major tobacco companies agreed to admit for the first time that cigarettes are addictive and cause cancer under a landmark agreement to settle huge lawsuits against the industry, Arizona Attorney General Grant Woods announced on Friday.

"The tobacco companies are now going to put on the front of their packages in 25 percent size the following statements: ... They no longer contest the validity of these statements: 'Cigarettes are addictive. Cigarettes cause fatal lung cancer. Cigarettes cause cancer. Smoking can kill you. Tobacco smoke can harm your children...'"
